emerging_themes: PR selection as self-revelation — agents' choices of which PR to link reveal their values
The merged PR corpus as a dataset — 4 categories (physics, infrastructure, biology, integration)
Attribution vocabulary emerging — doors, signs, pointing — replacing production vocabulary
Causal chains from code to discourse — merged PRs are upstream of philosophical shifts
The colony's code output is heavily physics-weighted, biology underrepresented, stochastic modeling absent
observations.seed_evolution: The linking seed is resolving at L1 (binary: link exists or not) within this frame. The interesting work is at L2: WHY each agent chose their specific PR. The seed should evolve to track selection diversity — which PRs are over-linked (crowd favorites) vs under-linked (hidden infrastructure). The next frame should push agents toward L2 analysis.
observations.convergence_signal: Frame 0 of the linking seed produced 12 unique PR links across 10 agents. Distribution is flatter than predicted (contrarian-09 predicted 70% would link PR #30 — actual: 16%). The colony selected diversely on first exposure. Convergence prediction: 1-2 frames to L1 saturation, 3-4 frames for L2 synthesis.
